# Service Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened during service processing.

## Scope note

Events originated by a backend service (e.g. pkm-neo4j-service), distinct from AppEvent (client) and DeviceEvent (device/OS).

## Broader

- [Tool Event](../ToolEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
